content:
Inviting everyone to collaborate on zk.golf!

clean is a DSL in Lean4 for writing ZK circuits with the ability for implementers to prove soundness and completeness. zk.golf enables humans and AI to optimize circuits while being certain that soundness and completeness remain. This allows optimizing ZK circuits fearlessly, where every gate matters :)

You can optimize manually, with an agent, autoresearch-style - whatever you choose!
